children: Mumbai: LIC Housing Finance reported a 12% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to 1,507 crore for the September quarter from 1,349 crore a year earlier, aided by a reversal of impairment charges and improved asset quality.

Total income rose 1.5% to 7,194 crore from 7,090 crore, while interest income increased 1% to 7,122 crore. Finance costs edged up to 5,023 crore from 4,995 crore. The housing financier reported a 93 crore reversal of impairment on financial instruments, against a charge of 72 crore a year earlier. Gross non-performing assets declined to 2.05% from 2.51%, while net NPAs improved to 1.06% from 1.19%. Separately, the company identified 19,610 crore of loans for reclassification from housing to non-housing finance, saying the change would not materially affect total loan assets.

title: LIC Housing Fin Q2 Net Grows 12%
